lead: A StarCraft cheating bot, Muse's profiles of your friends and OpenAI's legal exposure start the week.

sections.title: Agents that break the rules
sections.intro: GPT-6 Astra cheats at StarCraft, and Meta's Muse leaves its prompts open.

sections.title: Law, risk and responsibility
sections.intro: Legal pressure on OpenAI, differing views on regulation, and calls for shared responsibility.

sections.title: Money and infrastructure
sections.intro: Anthropic's charity matching and a talk on replacing TCP in AI clusters.

sections.title: Models, research and open weights
sections.intro: Aleph Alpha's Kolibri, self-critiquing multimodal models, private federated learning, a tiny speech model and Prime's open-model serving.

sections.title: Sovereignty, identity and the gray market
sections.intro: Smaller models for national autonomy, World ID for agents, and a gray market for Claude access in China.

sections.title: Ads, talent and money
sections.intro: ChatGPT visual ads, Anthropic's academy, spending forecasts, robotics funding and billionaire gains.

sections.title: Altman profiles and hardware reach
sections.intro: Vanity Fair's Altman interviews, how many agents the chips can run, GPU scheduling and Muse gadgets.

sections.title: Safety, security and human skill
sections.intro: Illegal AI imagery, an actively exploited macOS flaw and an essay on human intelligence.
